# berge-fulkerson remaining original proof source and historical body archive

863 original bodies, 319 code files. Original remaining local star, pairing, Fano, jointcarrier, globalclosure, repair and scratch bodies retain rejected and corrected interfaces. Matched scientific fixtures are byte-checked as provenance, not logical verification. Z3, NetworkX, geng and branch-specific model scripts/inputs are external or separately archived. The complete large note102 record remains historical unknown_at_inner_A, not unrestricted acceptance.

This REVIEW checks archival scope and original byte preservation, not mathematical validity or fresh computational truth. Existing human/AI attribution and own original text/data CC BY4.0/code Apache2 grants apply; citations retain source rights. Exact source/public hashes, locator projections and historical status remain explicit. No research code, solver or proof checker was executed.
